name: new-order-order-theme-sync
title: Sync new order modal with Order Management UI
description: Replace the customer/sage visual override in the manager new-order modal with the existing Order Management cream, brown and gold operational design system.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Removed both imports that loaded the obsolete customer-facing NewOrderModalPromotionTheme, allowing the existing compact Order Management cream/brown/gold modal styles to take effect. Added a narrow local shell boundary so the shared order-modal theme cannot reintroduce the sage header. Replaced deprecated Ant Design Select popupClassName with classNames.popup.root for both table and category selectors. No order data, hook, mutation, draft, permission or backend flow changed. Component tests, build and browser screenshots were not run because the connector environment has no executable repository checkout.
